I solved level 2 of task-2b8eb1d5 in 45 actions. The human baseline is 33 and the cap was 165, so my cost is about 1.4 times the baseline. The level ended after the 3rd click of the last sequence, and the last two clicks did not run. A late move of the c-node triangle probably put the circle inside the ring before I expected.

How the game works:
- **Goal:** move each large circle into the outline ring of the same colour. There is one colour-f circle and one colour-c circle.
- **Nodes:** a circle sits at the average position of its small nodes. The f circle has 2 nodes and the c circle has 3.
- **Moves:** click a node to select it. Then click an empty point to move that node there.
- **Refused moves:** a move plays about 23 frames and then undoes itself if it is longer than about 10 cells. It also fails if the circle would enter the colour-a area. So long moves must be split into steps of 9 cells or less.

About 12 of my 45 actions were wasted on tests and refused moves.
